text:
Type: pair of white linen curtains
Use: filtering daylight and softening windows; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, coastal
Materials: semi-sheer woven linen with a slubby natural texture, hidden tab heading
Colors: white, faint warm off-white
Shape: two long straight panels hanging in loose soft folds from a rod, airy translucent weave, plain hems, light and flowing
Feel: airy, calm, natural, bright
Goes with: light wood floors, white walls, rattan, pale grey or sand textiles; Scandinavian, coastal or Japandi rooms

product.name: AINA
product.description: The curtains lower the general light level and provide privacy by preventing people outside from seeing directly into the room.
